examples.japanese: {小銭|こぜに}がないので{払|はら}えない。
examples.english: I can't pay because I don't have any change.

examples.japanese: {財布|さいふ}に{小銭|こぜに}がたまっている。
examples.english: Coins have accumulated in my wallet.

examples.japanese: {小銭|こぜに}を{両替|りょうがえ}してください。
examples.english: Please give me change for this (bill).

notes:
{小銭|こぜに} refers to coins or small change.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小銭|こぜに}がある/ない (to have/not have change)
- {小銭|こぜに}を{持|も}つ (to carry change)
- {小銭|こぜに}を{出|だ}す (to take out coins)
- {小銭|こぜに}がたまる (coins accumulate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小銭|こぜに}: coins, small change (casual)
- {硬貨|こうか}: coins (formal/technical)
- おつり: change (what you receive back)

USEFUL EXPRESSIONS:
- {小銭|こぜに}{入|い}れ (coin purse)
- {小銭|こぜに}を{崩|くず}す (to break a bill into coins)
